input.summary: Insert HDI IP indemnity as Section 9(c) with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's third-party IP infringement indemnity for the Site and its services as Section 9(c), with the customary Company modification, combination and specification exclusions, the procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a cap of three times annual fees. This sits at our fallback position; adding a duty to defend, cover for the Company's affiliates and a notice/control/cooperation mechanic would meet our preferred position.

ops.text: (c) HDI shall indemnify the Company against any third-party claim alleging that the Site or the services provided by HDI under this Agreement infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from modifications made by the Company, combination of the Site with items not supplied by HDI, or the Company's specifications. HDI shall procure for the Company the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of those remedies is reasonably available, HDI shall refund the fees paid by the Company for the affected item. HDI's total liability under this Section 9(c) shall not exceed three (3) times the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
